# Exit codes

| Code | Name | Command family | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `completed` | Workflow run (`session run`, `session continue`) | when the session is completed. |
| 0 | `completed` | Workflow run with `--once` or `--stage` | when the stage outcome is complete, or the session is already completed. |
| 0 | `completed` | Role run (`session run --role`) | when the outcome is complete, or the role session is already completed. |
| 0 | `completed` | Authoring (`config\|workflow validate\|render\|save`) | ok (warnings allowed). |
| 0 | `completed` | `doctor` | when every check passes. |
| 0 | `completed` | `get` | on success, including an empty list. |
| 0 | `completed` | `session complete` | on success and when already completed. |
| 1 | `blocked` | Workflow run (`session run`, `session continue`) | when the session is blocked. session continue runs that stage again. |
| 1 | `blocked` | Workflow run with `--once` or `--stage` | when the stage is not complete, or the session is blocked. |
| 1 | `blocked` | Role run (`session run --role`) | when the outcome is not complete. |
| 1 | `blocked` | Authoring (`config\|workflow validate\|render\|save`) | for an invalid draft. |
| 1 | `blocked` | `doctor` | when a check fails. |
| 2 | `config` | Workflow run (`session run`, `session continue`) | on a configuration error. |
| 2 | `config` | Workflow run with `--once` or `--stage` | on a configuration error. |
| 2 | `config` | Role run (`session run --role`) | on a configuration error. |
| 2 | `config` | Preflight before a workflow run | when the preflight check finds a problem. Nothing is created or frozen. Pass --skip-preflight to bypass it. |
| 2 | `config` | Authoring (`config\|workflow validate\|render\|save`) | for an invocation or I/O error. |
| 2 | `config` | `doctor` | for an invalid session id or an unreadable session. |
| 2 | `config` | `get` | on a usage or configuration error, or when the name is not found. |
| 2 | `config` | `session complete` | on a usage error or an invalid session. |
| 3 | `stage_failed` | Workflow run (`session run`, `session continue`) | when a stage fails. The session stays active. |
| 3 | `stage_failed` | Workflow run with `--once` or `--stage` | when a non-continue --once or --stage finds a failed stage with no resume marker. |
| 3 | `stage_failed` | Authoring (`config\|workflow validate\|render\|save`) | for a conflict (`stale-base`, `already-exists`, `session-locked`). |
| 4 | `revisions_exhausted` | Workflow run (`session run`, `session continue`) | when a route would exceed max_revisions. The session stays active. |
| 4 | `revisions_exhausted` | Workflow run with `--once` or `--stage` | when a route would exceed max_revisions. The session stays active. |
| 5 | `dispatch_limit` | Workflow run (`session run`, `session continue`) | when --max-dispatches is spent. The session stays active. |
| 6 | `verify_exhausted` | Workflow run (`session run`, `session continue`) | when verify fails max_verify times. The session stays active. |
| 6 | `verify_exhausted` | Workflow run with `--once` or `--stage` | when verify fails max_verify times. The session stays active. |
| 6 | `verify_exhausted` | Role run (`session run --role`) | when a cancelled role session reopened more than one execution and one exhausted verify. |
| 7 | `verify_failed` | Workflow run (`session run`, `session continue`) | when a stage with no role fails verify. The session stays active. |
| 7 | `verify_failed` | Workflow run with `--once` or `--stage` | when a stage with no role fails verify. The session stays active. |
| 8 | `quota` | Workflow run (`session run`, `session continue`) | when --once or --stage hits a client quota. The session stays active. |
| 8 | `quota` | Workflow run with `--once` or `--stage` | when --once or --stage hits a client quota. |
| 9 | `question` | Workflow run (`session run`, `session continue`) | when waiting for a reply to a question. |
| 9 | `question` | Workflow run with `--once` or `--stage` | when waiting for a reply to a question. |
| 10 | `resume_expired` | Workflow run (`session run`, `session continue`) | when a resume waits for a decision after the prompt cache expired. session resume decides it. |
| 10 | `resume_expired` | Workflow run with `--once` or `--stage` | when a resume waits for a decision after the prompt cache expired. |
| 10 | `resume_expired` | Role run (`session run --role`) | when a resume waits for a decision after the prompt cache expired. |
| 10 | `resume_expired` | Resume after the prompt cache expired (`session resume`) | when another resume still waits for a decision. |
| 130 | `cancelled` | Workflow run (`session run`, `session continue`) | when cancelled. session continue resumes that execution. |
| 130 | `cancelled` | Workflow run with `--once` or `--stage` | when cancelled. session continue resumes that execution. |
| 130 | `cancelled` | Role run (`session run --role`) | when cancelled. session continue resumes that execution. |
